subject: folded-paper robot
art_direction: 方圆纸壳机器人一只小手举起，蓝灰与桃色像素构成温和机械感。
visible_description: 方圆纸壳机器人一只小手举起，蓝灰与桃色像素构成温和机械感。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Design a compact robot in pixel art as if made from folded paper panels, with a rounded-square head and short blocky limbs. One small hand rises in a restrained wave. Use blue-gray panels with peach inner folds and a modest friendly face. Keep all edges aligned to a consistent pixel grid, with just three shade levels and warm ivory background, avoiding screen text or electrical effects. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
